records.label: Profile Name / Key / Description / Tags / Note
records.notes: Name required, generated stable key, description, Draft/Active status, normalized tags and internal note; the key never encodes scope and the note never reaches logs/events unless sanitized. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Identity.

records.label: Profile Lifecycle (Draft / Active / Archived)
records.notes: Only Active profiles can be previewed for execution; Archived profiles keep history linkage; deleting a definition never deletes run history or restore-point references. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1, §3 Identity.

records.label: Profiles List Columns
records.notes: Name, key, status, scope summary, preservation summary, backup requirement, last executed, last result, created/updated and actions; summaries are computed, never free text. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1.

records.label: Profiles List Filters
records.notes: Status, scope type, backup required, last result and date filters; search by name/key/tags only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1.

records.label: Profile Row Actions (Edit / Duplicate / Preview / Run / Export / Archive)
records.notes: Run always routes through impact preview, restore-point policy and confirmation; Duplicate copies definition only (never restore-point bindings or run state); delete of a definition is archive-first. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1.

records.label: Bulk Run Disabled
records.notes: No bulk Run action exists; each execution is a single previewed, confirmed and audited run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1; docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Rejected-unsafe.

records.label: Reset Preset (WPE Config Only / WPE Module Data + Config / Content / Settings / Dev-Staging / Near-Factory / Custom)
records.notes: Preset only populates explicit scope options and never hides what will be deleted; WPE configuration only is the default suggestion; Near-factory is Level 3 and never the default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Reset type/preset.

records.label: Preset Expands to Visible Explicit Scope
records.notes: Changing a preset rewrites visible explicit selections; the saved profile stores the expanded scope, not only the preset key, so preset evolution never silently changes a saved profile. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Reset type/preset.

records.label: Near-Factory Site Reset Preset
records.notes: Composed only of registered owner scopes (content, taxonomy, comments, registered settings, WPE data) with mandatory preservation; never a raw DB drop/reinstall; Level 3 confirmation and verified pre-reset restore point mandatory. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §8, §11, §15.

records.label: Development / Staging Reset Preset
records.notes: Allowed only where environment policy marks the site non-production when such identity exists; environment identity/cloning stays Surface 55 Staging. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3; docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Canonical ownership.

records.label: All / Selected WPE Modules
records.notes: Explicit module selection; each module contributes only scopes its owner registers. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Definitions Only
records.notes: Resets saved definitions/config while leaving runtime data untouched by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Per-Module Runtime Data (Optional)
records.notes: Runtime delete requires the module-specific delete contract; no generic table wipe; modules without a contract are shown as not resettable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4; §11.

records.label: Preserve WPE Audit History
records.notes: Default on; audit history of the reset itself is always written regardless of selection. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §12.

records.label: Preserve Account Connection
records.notes: Default on; account/Vault connections are never silently reset by presets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §12; docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Market audit required.

records.label: Preserve Support Ticket Local Cache
records.notes: Default on. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §12.

records.label: Preserve Vault Credentials
records.notes: Default on unless explicitly selected; selecting Vault reset is Level 3 with an explicit per-reference list; secret values never appear in preview, events or logs. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §12.

records.label: Module Activation State (Preserve / Reset)
records.notes: Preserve default; reset re-applies registry defaults through the module lifecycle, never by deleting module files. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4; §10.

records.label: Reset Onboarding State
records.notes: Level 1 when alone; re-shows onboarding without touching data. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4; §15 Level 1.

records.label: Reset License / Entitlement Local Cache
records.notes: Clears local cache only; the account entitlement source of truth is never altered. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Clear Diagnostics / Local Caches
records.notes: Level 1 cache/local UI-state reset. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4; §15 Level 1.

records.label: Clear Generated Assets / Caches
records.notes: Regenerable outputs only; rebuild is a post-reset action. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4; §18.

records.label: Post Types / Statuses Selector
records.notes: Registered post types/statuses (get_post_types/get_post_stati substrate) select scope; WP-CLI `site empty` is a precedent for whole-site emptying, which WPE never offers unscoped. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Author / Term / Date Range / Explicit IDs Filters
records.notes: Typed filters combined with AND semantics; preview shows matched counts and samples. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Query Builder Definition Selector
records.notes: Selection via a saved Query Builder definition owned by Surface 4; the definition is snapshotted into the preview fingerprint. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Relation-Driven Selection
records.notes: Only when relation owners support it; deferred until Relations delete contracts exist. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Trash vs Permanent Delete
records.notes: wp_trash_post()/wp_delete_post() substrate with native hooks; trash default where WP entity semantics support it; permanent delete is Level 2+. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Revisions / Autosaves
records.notes: Native revision/autosave records follow parent selection; standalone revision cleanup belongs to DB Maintenance (Surface 48). Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5; docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Canonical ownership.

records.label: Comments Tied to Selected Content
records.notes: Native post deletion cascades comments; preview counts them explicitly. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §7.

records.label: Post Meta
records.notes: Removed through native delete APIs with the post; no raw postmeta SQL. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Term Relationships of Selected Content
records.notes: Native wp_delete_post() clears relationships; terms themselves stay unless Taxonomy scope selects them. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §6.

records.label: Media Handling (Keep / Detach / Delete Exclusive / Delete Selected)
records.notes: Keep attachments is default; delete exclusively-attached media is advanced; delete regardless of usage only with dependency impact preview. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Media handling.

records.label: Original + Derivative File Deletion
records.notes: wp_delete_attachment() media ownership rules govern originals and generated sizes; files outside the uploads ownership model are never touched. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Media handling.

records.label: Child Posts / Attachments Behavior
records.notes: Explicit choice per hierarchy; default keeps children and reparents per native behaviour. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Orphan Relationship Cleanup via Owners
records.notes: Only through owning modules' cleanup contracts. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Taxonomies / Terms Selection
records.notes: Registered taxonomies/terms via wp_delete_term() substrate. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Relationships Only vs Term Delete
records.notes: Relationships-only uses wp_set_object_terms() semantics; term delete is explicit. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Term Meta
records.notes: Deleted with the term by native API. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Preserve Default / Core Terms + Fallback Reassignment
records.notes: Default category cannot be deleted natively; posts reassigned to fallback term where core requires. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Hierarchy Child Behavior
records.notes: Explicit choice; native default reparents children. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: WPE Relation Dependency Impact
records.notes: Preview lists WPE relations, listings and queries depending on selected terms. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6, §14.

records.label: All / Status / Type / Linked Content / Date Range
records.notes: wp_delete_comment() substrate; selection never via broad SQL. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Trash / Spam / Permanent Behavior
records.notes: Native comment trash/spam/delete semantics; permanent delete Level 2+. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Comment Meta
records.notes: Removed with the comment by native API. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Registered Option Group Selection
records.notes: Normal mode exposes only registered/known groups (register_setting substrate, WPE module settings, owner adapters); arbitrary option names are never listed for deletion. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Transients / Cache Groups
records.notes: delete_transient()/wp_cache_flush() substrate; safe and regenerable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Rewrite / Permalink Generated Caches via Safe Repair
records.notes: flush_rewrite_rules() once as a repair action only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8; §18.

records.label: Selected Integration Settings via Owner Adapters
records.notes: Only owners exposing a reset adapter appear. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Preserve Site Identity / URLs
records.notes: Default on: siteurl/home, blogname and URLs preserved. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8, §12.

records.label: Preserve Admin Email / Default Role / Timezone
records.notes: Default on unless a full baseline intentionally changes them, shown in preview. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Reset to WordPress Defaults Where Deterministic
records.notes: populate_options()-equivalent defaults only for deterministic keys; non-deterministic options listed as not resettable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: User Deletion Excluded from Standard Presets
records.notes: No standard preset deletes users; market tools that keep only the current user are a different (rejected) model. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Advanced User Reset (Selected Users / Roles / Date / Query)
records.notes: Spec: 'if accepted later'; deferred until owner acceptance with Surface 30 Roles/Policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Preserve Current Operator (Mandatory)
records.notes: Mandatory; cannot be disabled. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §12.

records.label: Preserve At Least One Recovery Administrator (Mandatory)
records.notes: Mandatory; failure state blocks the run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §23.

records.label: Multisite Super Admin Protection
records.notes: is_super_admin() substrate; Super Admins never in subsite scope. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §24.

records.label: Reassign Authored Content vs Delete
records.notes: wp_delete_user() reassign parameter substrate; wpmu_delete_user() for network. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: User Meta / Membership / Seats / Roles / Personal-Data Impact
records.notes: Part of the deferred advanced user reset. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Preserve Installed Packages
records.notes: Default on and not disableable in ordinary profiles; package removal is not reset. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Preserve Active Theme
records.notes: Default on; switch_theme() only if explicitly configured. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Preserve Active Plugin State
records.notes: Default on. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Deactivate / Reactivate Selected Plugins After Reset
records.notes: deactivate_plugins()/activate_plugin() substrate; reactivation failures reported, never fatal. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10, §18, §23.

records.label: Clear Plugin / Theme Caches via Certified Adapter
records.notes: Certified adapters only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: WPE Module-Owned Runtime Tables
records.notes: Only through registered owners and their delete contracts. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Custom Tables Builder Tables (Explicit)
records.notes: Explicit selection; schema change requires wpe_reset_schema. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11, §20.

records.label: Rows Matched via Typed Query / Filters
records.notes: Typed filters only, no free-form WHERE. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Truncate / Drop When Owner Contract Allows
records.notes: Only if the owning contract explicitly allows and impact is known. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Mandatory Safety Preservation
records.notes: Current admin/recovery admin, salts/secrets file, backup catalog/restore point and the reset audit cannot be disabled in normal mode. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Preserve Site URL / Home URL
records.notes: Default on. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: wp-config / Salts Untouched
records.notes: Never modified by reset. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Preserve Backup Catalog / Restore Points
records.notes: Mandatory; Surface 24 owns restore-point truth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12; Surface 24 backup.set.protect-restore-point.

records.label: Preserve Selected Posts / Users / Terms / Tables / Option Groups
records.notes: Explicit preservation lists. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Preserve Uploads / Custom Paths
records.notes: Default on; uploads are only touched through media ownership rules. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12, §5.

records.label: Preservation Precedence Rules
records.notes: Explicit preservation beats broad preset; mandatory safety preservation cannot be disabled without separately accepted unsafe mode. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12 Conflict resolution.

records.label: Restore Point Mode (Required default / Existing Recent Verified / Create New)
records.notes: Required is default; verified pre-reset restore point produced by Surface 24 Backup (trigger Pre-Reset); never silently downgraded. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13; Surface 24 backup.set.trigger.

records.label: Minimum Verification Tier
records.notes: V1/V2 according to environment policy; tier semantics owned by Surface 24. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13; Surface 24 backup.set.verification-tier.

records.label: Maximum Restore-Point Age
records.notes: Reuse an existing verified point only within configured age. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Preferred Backup Destination
records.notes: Destination reference resolved by Surface 24. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Protect Restore Point Until Reset Closed
records.notes: Protected from retention until reset is closed; remains protected after a failed reset. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13; §25.

records.label: Remove Protection After Successful Verification
records.notes: Toggle; only after post-reset verification passes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Block When Backup Engine Unhealthy
records.notes: Reset blocked, not silently downgraded. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13, §23.

records.label: Recorded Unsafe Override (Waiver)
records.notes: Only when dedicated capability wpe_reset_unsafe_override and policy permit; requires reason, typed phrase and recent re-auth; recorded in audit; never available to AI or presets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13, §20.

records.label: Restore-Point Proof Bound to Run
records.notes: Run records restore-point id, tier and verification timestamp, re-validated immediately before the destructive phase. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13, §16.

records.label: Impact Preview Counts / Estimates
records.notes: Posts/revisions/comments, terms, media/files, users, options, WPE definitions/runtime rows, tables, jobs, entitlements, plugin/theme changes, retained items and restore-point state. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Dry-Run (Preview Without Execution)
records.notes: Preview is a read-only dry run with no side effects; required before every run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14; §2.1.

records.label: Preview Fingerprint / Version
records.notes: Records relevant source counts/versions. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Material Drift Re-Evaluation
records.notes: Safety-critical scope re-evaluated before execution; critical drift requires new preview or blocks; non-critical within declared tolerance. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14; §25.

records.label: Dependency / Jobs / Workflow Impact
records.notes: Active jobs, workflows, memberships and relations affected. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Confirmation Level 1 / 2 / 3
records.notes: Level derived from scope, never chosen lower by the user. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Level 2 Summary + Acknowledgement
records.notes: Explicit summary, checkbox acknowledgement and confirmation button with verified recovery point. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Recent Re-Authentication
records.notes: Level 3; nonce (wp_verify_nonce) alone is not re-auth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Typed Site / Profile Phrase
records.notes: Phrase includes site/profile identifiers, not a generic word. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Reason / Audit Note
records.notes: Required at Level 3. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Optional Accessible Countdown
records.notes: Optional; never relied on as security. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Execution Phases
records.notes: queued/preflight/validating restore point/locking/maintenance/content/taxonomy+comments/module/settings/users/plugins-themes/cache-rewrite/post-verify/completed/completed_with_warnings/failed_recoverable/failed_recovery_required; idempotency/recovery-aware. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16.

records.label: Phased Background Execution
records.notes: Job Service (Surface 18) over WP-Cron substrate; no long in-request destructive loop. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16.

records.label: Maintenance / Recovery State
records.notes: wp_maintenance() substrate entered only when required. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16.

records.label: Block Concurrent Reset / Restore / Destructive Import / Schema Migration
records.notes: Backup creation is a prerequisite phase, not concurrent. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §17.

records.label: Stale Lock Recovery
records.notes: Explicit diagnostics and safe ownership/expiry rules. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §17.

records.label: Explicit Failure States
records.notes: No verified restore point, stale point, disk, DB permissions, last recovery admin, owner unavailable, protected data, lock conflict, midway failure, boot/health failure, reactivation failure, multisite unsupported, backup unavailable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §23.

records.label: Rollback Claimed Only When Verified
records.notes: Failure never implies rollback completed unless restore verification proves it. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §23.

records.label: Recovery Screen
records.notes: Failure summary, safe diagnostic ID, restore-point health, boot health, recommended actions and support bundle. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.3.

records.label: Support Bundle
records.notes: Redacted; no deleted payloads or secrets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.3.

records.label: Safe Post-Reset Actions
records.notes: Flush rewrites once, clear WPE caches, rebuild definition caches, rebuild entitlements, regenerate derived media if required, reactivate validated modules/plugins. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Redirect to Onboarding / Home / Recovery
records.notes: Destination determined by result. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Notification + Reset Report
records.notes: Delivery via Surface 19 Notifications; safe summary only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Post-Reset Verification / Health Checks
records.notes: WP_Site_Health substrate plus WPE boot checks. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16, §25.

records.label: Reset History Columns
records.notes: Run ID, profile/manual, operator, requested vs actual scope, restore-point ref, times, phase, result, recovery state. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2.

records.label: Browser Screenshot Before Reset
records.notes: Optional planning feature only; auxiliary evidence, not recovery artifact. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §19.

records.label: Video Recording
records.notes: Not promised until a separate client/browser architecture exists. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §19.

records.label: Reset Capabilities
records.notes: read/profile CRUD/preview/run/history/recover/execute/unsafe_override/users/schema separated (current_user_can substrate). Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §20.

records.label: High-Risk Capability Separation
records.notes: unsafe_override, users and schema are never in ordinary presets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §20.

records.label: Abilities: list / get / preview / validate / status / recovery_status
records.notes: AI default exposure read/preview/explain only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §21.

records.label: Run / Recovery Abilities Disabled for AI by Default
records.notes: Mutating abilities off by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §21.

records.label: Typed Reset Events
records.notes: previewed/requested/started/phase_changed/completed/failed/recovery_required/recovered; counts/IDs only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22.

records.label: Audit Safe Summary
records.notes: Audit contains safe summary only; never deleted private payloads. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22, §25.

records.label: Subsite Reset Boundary
records.notes: is_multisite()/get_sites() substrate; never touches network users/options; network-active packages preserved. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24.

records.label: Network-Wide / Full Multisite Reset
records.notes: Requires separate explicit support/certification; off by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24.

records.label: Unsupported Mode Blocked with Explanation
records.notes: No best-effort destructive action. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24.

records.label: Personal-Data Retention Conflicts
records.notes: WordPress privacy tooling is the native reference; reset is not a privacy erasure workflow. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9; docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Native audit.

records.label: Profile Export / Import
records.notes: Definitions only without restore-point bindings; package movement owned by Surface 26. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1.

records.label: Accessible Destructive Flow
records.notes: Keyboard wizard, focus-managed confirmation, non-colour progress, no fake completion. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15; docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md family 19.

records.label: Chunked / Paginated Deletion
records.notes: Bounded batches resumable through Job Service. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16; docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md family 19.

records.label: One-Click Full Reset
records.notes: Rejected: no normal one-click reset; every run is previewed, confirmed and audited. Evidence: docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1.

records.label: Full Database Wipe / Reinstall

coverage.notes: All 148 Reset records are classified from docs/MODULES/RESET-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md and docs/PRODUCT/RESET-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md (89 WPE_HARD, 19 NATIVE_HARD, 5 SOFT_NATIVE, 4 WPE_EXCEED, 6 DEFERRED and 25 REJECTED_UNSAFE). Native WordPress post/comment/term/user/option/plugin/theme/multisite/maintenance/Site Health primitives are deletion substrate only; every run requires scope selection, a read-only dry-run impact preview, a verified pre-reset restore point from Surface 24 Backup by default (only a recorded, capability-gated unsafe override with reason, typed phrase and re-auth may waive it), level-based typed confirmation with re-auth, audit, no network-wide reset by default and no deletion outside WPE-owned scope by default; 6 items are deferred and 25 unsafe patterns stay rejected.
